message.content:
**Pantone Sky Blue**

| Pantone Code | Description |
|--------------|-------------|
| **PANTONE 290 C** | “Sky Blue” (Coated) – a bright, airy blue often used in fashion and interior design. |
| **PANTONE 290 U** | “Sky Blue” (Uncoated) – the same hue but formulated for uncoated paper or textiles. |

> *Note:* Pantone also offers variations such as 2905 C/U for slightly deeper tones, but 290 C/U is the standard reference for “sky blue.”
